tagline: Pentacon取景器相机，1967 年发布
description: Pentacon于1967年推出的取景器相机。配备Meyer-Optik Görlitz Domiplan 45 mm f/2.8 (3 elements, coated). Closest distance is 1 m (3 feet). Focussing is only guesswork supported by symbols for landscape, groups and portrait.。使用SL System cartridges, thumb wheel in the back for film advance, frame counter (counts down from 12).。

specs.镜头: Meyer-Optik Görlitz Domiplan 45 mm f/2.8 (3 elements, coated). Closest distance is 1 m (3 feet). Focussing is only guesswork supported by symbols for landscape, groups and portrait.
specs.取景器: simple telescopic type, no further frame or parallax indicators.
specs.胶片/画幅: SL System cartridges, thumb wheel in the back for film advance, frame counter (counts down from 12).
specs.英文简介: The Pentacon electra is an innovative camera introduced 1967 by Pentacon.
